preview.text: Bulgaria Women won the toss and chose to bat first in their T20 match against Sweden Women at Moara Vlasiei Cricket Ground in Bucharest. The usual first-innings score in the 30 recorded T20 matches at this venue is 110. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to an 88 per cent chance of rain and about 9 degrees.

summary.text: BGRW scored 98-9 in their innings with Tanaya Dissanayake top scoring with 35 off 38 balls while Hariharan Shreya took 2 for 16. SWEW responded with 99-0 as Anya Vaidya (wk) top scored with 75 off 25 balls to secure a 10 wkt victory for Sweden Women.
